cross_component_finding: PAIR JUDGMENT (keepLastN vs advanced-keepLastN, stated once here for the pair): a genuine elaboration, not a restatement. eventing-handler-keepLastN.md's userspace-CAS workaround (a 'random' tag reread/rewrite retry loop, up to 16 tries) and this page's true-CAS loop (couchbase.get/couchbase.replace in a while(res===null) loop) are structurally different implementations of the same goal, not the same code re-badged with a version number - only this page's mechanism is registered as eventing:cas-retry-loop.
